_about: Public-domain Janet Erskine Stuart (1857-1914), Superior General of the Society of the Sacred Heart, for the Word Hoard: The Education of Catholic Girls (1911, and Gutenberg's text of the 1914 fourth impression), The Society of the Sacred Heart (1914) and Highways and By-ways in the Spiritual Life, edited by Maud Monahan (1923), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
